page.overview:
Who is Cover Girl?

Cover Girl was the callsign of G.I. Joe team member Courtney Krieger. She was Hawk's aide-de-camp.

Cover Girl was seen always at Hawk's side, assisting him with the debriefing of the G.I. Joe Team and later in the certification of Duke and Ripcord as part of the Joe team. During the attack on the Pit, she was initially wary upon seeing an M.P. wandering the hallways, but soon turns her back on him to speak with Hawk. Unfortunately, the M.P. is actually Zartan, who stabs her in the back. Hawk attempts to retaliate before being over-powered by Storm Shadow. Zartan sadistically toys with Cover Girl while she was dying, earning him some verbal retorts from Storm Shadow. In response, he comments "That's right. You don't kill women," to which Storm Shadow tells him "For you, Zartan, I'll make an exception."

She is avenged when Storm Shadow later kills Zartan.
